text:
sam_sales: BigCorp wants a sealed-DC POC. their infosec insists on no egress; procurement is asking for delivery options + cost table. SEs/eng input?
marta_se: Clarify delivery: physical courier (encrypted USB) vs locked internal repo + one-way jumpbox sync. which do they prefer?
sam_sales: Legal prefers physical chain-of-custody. ops says courier costs may kill the deal. they asked for a lower-cost 'cassette' delta approach.
owen_eng: Technical constraints: we can do full image USB or initial image + signed deltas. deltas must be Notary v2 manifests with sha256 entries; device verifies manifest before apply.
leah_sec: PSQ asks: can we support customer-owned signing keys and FIPS-backed HSMs? and do we provide SBOMs?
marta_se: Yes — BYO notary key supported; we can sign using a customer HSM or provide signed artifacts under an SOW. SBOMs available in SPDX with checksums and detached signature if they require.
tom_ops: Lead times: first full image ~5-8 business days (build, sign, QA, pack). approved deltas 48-72 hours after delta pipeline is whitelisted.
sam_sales: They want patch cadence commitment: monthly security; feature deltas only on request. can we promise monthly security for POC?
owen_eng: For a 90-day POC we can commit to monthly security deltas and ad-hoc hotfixes within SLA. must include pre-approval gate on their side.
leah_sec: Telemetry: default disabled in sealed installs. we can offer a customer-managed pull node for optional heartbeat (explicit opt-in).
marta_se: Pricing: include a one-time handling fee, per-shipment embargo premium, and optional freight-insurance/tamper-evident packaging line items.
sam_sales: Next steps: Owen to draft a one-page runbook (media options, signing flows, manifest format, SBOM+signature format, cadence, rollbacks, lead times). Marta/Leah will review PSQ language. I'll send to buyer by EOD tomorrow.
ship-bot: sealed-image build #7210 succeeded — artifact: sealed-image-2026-04-02.tar.gz (sha256: fedcba987654...)
own_eng: Drafting runbook now, will post link in thread before 10:30am PST sync.
sam_sales: Thanks — scheduling 10:30am PST review.
